nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances per address (mapping(address => uint256) _rOwned); the authoritative internal balance ledger.
Nested allowance mapping (mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowances).
Mapping flagging addresses exempt from transfer tax.
Total reflections; reduced by fees in _reflectFee (arithmetic-sensitive).
Cumulative token fees collected.
Burn/team fee percentage used in _getTValues.
Tax fee percentage; mutable through lowerTax.
Privileged tax collector address; compared against msg.sender and receives ETH.
Max buy limit enforced on pair buys; raised to _tTotal by removeBuyLimit.
Uniswap V2 router interface used for swaps and liquidity.
Created liquidity pair address used to detect buys/sells.
Trading-enabled flag toggled by startTrading/endTrading.
Reentrancy lock flag set by lockTheSwap around swap operations.
Controls whether contract-held tokens are auto-swapped for ETH during transfers.
Ownable owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Constructor: sets tax wallet to msg.sender, fee rates, router, initial reflections and max tx amount.
ERC20 transfer entry point; forwards msg.sender as from to _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom; calls _transfer then decrements allowance.
ERC20 approve; writes _allowances via _approve.
_transfer: core transfer logic with tax, max-tx limit, external router-amount check, and in-transfer swap/ETH send.
_tokenTransfer: thin wrapper delegating to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard: derives r/t values, updates _rOwned, takes team fee, reflects fee, emits Transfer.
_takeTeam: mints reflection team share to the contract address.
_reflectFee: reduces _rTotal by rFee and increases _tFeeTotal.
swapTokensForEth: approves and swaps contract tokens to ETH via the Uniswap router, guarded by lockTheSwap.
sendETHToFee: forwards contract ETH to the tax wallet using transfer.
startTrading: approves, creates the pair and adds liquidity, then enables trading and swapping.
endTrading: disables swapping and trading.
removeBuyLimit: sets _maxTxAmount to full supply; privileged function.
lowerTax: privileged reduction of _taxFee below INITIAL_TAX.
manualSwap: privileged call to swap the contract's token balance for ETH.
manualSend: privileged call to forward contract ETH balance to the tax wallet.
_approve: internal allowance write with zero-address checks.
tokenFromReflection: converts a reflection amount into token amount using _getRate.
balanceOf: returns token balance derived from _rOwned via tokenFromReflection.
_getValues: computes t and r transfer/fee values.
_getTValues: computes tFee, tTeam and tTransferAmount from tax rates.
_getRValues: scales t values into reflection values by currentRate.
_getRate: computes rSupply/tSupply ratio used throughout accounting.
_getCurrentSupply: returns reflection and token supply values.
renounceOwnership: onlyOwner function that zeroes _owner.
onlyTaxCollector modifier: requires _taxWallet == msg.sender, gating all privileged functions.
lockTheSwap modifier: sets _inSwap true/false around swap execution as a reentrancy guard.
msg.sender obtained through _msgSender(); controls owner, tax wallet and transfer origin.
block.timestamp used as swap and liquidity deadlines.
External call to _uniswap.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens during token transfers.
Native ETH transfer to _taxWallet using .transfer(amount).
External static call to the hardcoded ROUTER_ADDRESS via interface O(ROUTER_ADDRESS).amount(address(this)) executed on every transfer.
External call to _uniswap.addLiquidityETH sending the contract ETH balance.
External call to the factory createPair used to set _pair.
Arithmetic on reflection supply: _rTotal.sub(rFee) and _tFeeTotal.add(tFee) in _reflectFee.
recipient parameter of transfer.
amount parameter of transfer.
newTaxRate parameter of lowerTax.
tAmount parameter of _transferStandard.
from parameter of _transfer.
to parameter of _transfer.
amount parameter of _transfer.
contractTokenBalance local computed from balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance local holding address(this).balance inside _transfer.
currentRate local returned by _getRate in _getValues/_takeTeam/tokenFromReflection.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance move to _transfer before adjusting allowance.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer after its guards and optional swap logic.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard derives amounts from _getValues.
_getValues calls _getTValues for t-side amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for r-side amounts.
_getValues obtains currentRate from _getRate.
_getRate depends on _getCurrentSupply.
_transferStandard takes the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_takeTeam adds the reflection team amount to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal, altering the reflection supply.
_reflectFee performs the unchecked-by-inspection SafeMath add/sub on supply and fee totals.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth (external DEX call) inside the transfer path before the recipient balance is settled.
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee (native value transfer) inside the transfer path.
swapTokensForEth makes the external router swap call after only setting the _inSwap lock.
sendETHToFee performs a native ETH transfer to the tax wallet, an external interaction point.
_transfer performs an external interface call to the hardcoded ROUTER_ADDRESS on every transfer.
manualSwap is a privileged entry that reaches the external router swap.
manualSend is a privileged entry that reaches the native ETH transfer.
startTrading calls the factory createPair to set _pair.
startTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
swapTokensForEth uses the _uniswap router and its WETH accessor.
startTrading reads _uniswap for factory, WETH and addLiquidityETH.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
startTrading passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
msg.sender becomes the from address of the transfer path.
removeBuyLimit is gated by onlyTaxCollector.
lowerTax is gated by onlyTaxCollector.
manualSwap is gated by onlyTaxCollector.
manualSend is gated by onlyTaxCollector.
startTrading is gated by onlyTaxCollector.
endTrading is gated by onlyTaxCollector.
onlyTaxCollector equality check uses _taxWallet as the single privileged identity.
onlyTaxCollector compares msg.sender against _taxWallet to authorise privileged calls.
renounceOwnership is protected by onlyOwner reading _owner.
Constructor assigns _taxWallet from msg.sender.
Constructor initialises the _taxWallet state variable.
removeBuyLimit writes _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
lowerTax writes the new _taxFee value.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount buy limit.
lockTheSwap sets the _inSwap guard flag around the external swap call.
_getTValues uses _taxFee to compute the tax portion.
_getTValues uses _burnFee as the team fee rate.
_transfer compares from/to against _pair and reads the external amount via the router address.
_transfer gates the auto-swap on _swapEnabled.
_transfer gates the auto-swap on the _inSwap reentrancy flag.
balanceOf converts reflection balances via tokenFromReflection.
recipient parameter feeds the external transfer entry point.
amount parameter feeds the external transfer entry point.
newTaxRate parameter is validated and written into _taxFee.
tAmount parameter flows into the reflection accounting routine.
from parameter drives the sender balance debit.
to parameter drives the recipient balance credit.
amount parameter is used for limit checks and value derivation.
contractTokenBalance local is passed into swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance local determines the amount sent via sendETHToFee.
currentRate local is produced by _getRate and consumed by the accounting helpers.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer entry point and carries no independent state, so it collapses into fn_transfer.
The amount parameter is a transient argument of transfer and should be merged into fn_transfer.
newTaxRate is a transient argument validated and consumed entirely inside lowerTax.
tAmount is consumed immediately by _transferStandard's value derivation and has no standalone meaning.
The from parameter is a local argument of the internal transfer routine.
The to parameter is a local argument of the internal transfer routine.
The internal amount parameter is used only inside _transfer and can be folded into it.
contractTokenBalance is computed solely to be passed into swapTokensForEth and merges into that function.
contractETHBalance exists only to decide the amount forwarded by sendETHToFee and merges into it.
currentRate is the direct return value of _getRate cached by callers and should be represented by fn_getRate.
